ideas.pitch: A low-power agricultural IoT sensor node using LoRa for remote soil monitoring and automated irrigation control.
ideas.title: AgriSense IoT Node
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the Hardware Track by delivering a functional embedded prototype that solves a real-world agrarian problem, following the physical build success pattern.

ideas.pitch: An edge-computed computer vision waste classifier that automatically sorts dry and wet waste using a microcontroller.
ideas.title: SmartBin AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on a proven winning pattern of combining physical robotics with AI classification for an engaging live hardware demo.

ideas.pitch: A local edge-computing patient health telemetry monitor that detects anomalies and triggers instant local buzzer/SMS alerts.
ideas.title: MedWatch Edge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors hard-engineering biomedical IoT wins by showcasing real-time edge telemetry with practical medical utility.

ideas.pitch: An acoustic and peer-to-peer Wi-Fi Direct messaging app that operates completely offline during local network outages.
ideas.title: CampusMesh Offline Chat
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates complex networking without relying on internet infrastructure, appealing to judges looking for technical depth in software.

ideas.pitch: A timescale-powered energy consumption analytics dashboard with automated anomaly detection for smart buildings.
ideas.title: GridPulse Analytics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced time-series data storage and isolation forest anomaly detection similar to top hackathon-winning analytics pipelines.
